_doc: Tools (Tools, scripts/systems/tools.gd): each gathering tool has levels; you start on the first and buy the next at `seller`'s shop (shops.json lists the lines as {tool, level}). A level can say: price (lire) and items (materials) it costs, requires {quests, harmony, flags}, what the minigame is like (chop: width of the green, speed of the needle, rounds; mine: zone, the ring's speed, strikes; both: pause between swings), yield (extra of the main material per go), fells ("big": the big oaks, which give beams), dresses (each perfect strike also gives cut stone), unlocks (blueprints you get with it) and a short `does` line for the shop and the bag. A go where every swing is perfect gives `perfect_bonus` more.

levels.name: Steel axe
levels.does: Fells the big oaks for beams, and gets more wood from every tree.

levels.name: Woodcutter's axe
levels.does: Two swings a tree, and more wood and beams from each.

levels.name: Old pick
levels.does: Breaks stone and a little metal out of the rocks.

levels.name: Pick and chisel
levels.does: Every perfect strike dresses a block of cut stone, for arches and columns.

levels.name: Mason's pick
levels.does: Two strikes a rock, and more stone from each.
